{"problem": "你需要按照下述自定义运算规则计算结果。

【运算规则】
对两个关于 \((x,y)\) 的函数 \(f(x,y)\)、\(g(x,y)\)，定义
\[
 f■g=\frac{\partial f}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial g}{\partial x}.
\]

【题目】
已知
\[
 f(x,y)=\ln\left(\frac{x}{y}\right)+x^2\cos y,\qquad g(x,y)=\frac{y}{x^2}+\cos(xy).
\]
计算 \(f■g\)。

【作答要求】
用 LaTeX 表示，并将最终答案用双中括号包裹：[[...]]。", "canonical_answer": "[[\frac{1}{x}+2x\cos y-\frac{2y}{x^3}-y\sin(xy)]]", "attempts": [{"panel": 0, "sample": 0, "answer": "[[\frac{1}{x}+2x\cos y-\frac{2y}{x^3}-y\sin(xy)]]", "certificate": "由定义，f■g=∂f/∂x+∂g/∂x。∂f/∂x=1/x+2x cos y，∂g/∂x=−2y/x^3−y sin(xy)，相加即得所示结果。"}]}

message.content: {"verdict":"valid","reason":"按定义，分别对 f 和 g 关于 x 求偏导并相加：\\(\\partial f/\\partial x=1/x+2x\\cos y\\)，\\(\\partial g/\\partial x=-2y/x^3-y\\sin(xy)\\)。所得结果与标准答案一致。","error_types":[],"depth_score":2,"depth_evidence":"需要先应用自定义运算定义，再分别完成两个偏导计算并将结果相加。","reasoning_type_tags":["deduction","other"],"constraint_type_tags":["equality"],"scenario":"abstract","explanation_score":4,"explanation_evidence":"证书明确引用运算定义，正确给出两个偏导数，并说明相加得到最终表达式；与标准答案逐项一致。","solver_correct":[true]}
